text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is above my average cost can turn a paper gain into a realized one without improving my portfolio; I should base sales on my plan, not the pleasure of locking in a win.","Small month-to-month account changes are not reliable signals in a random market, so I should avoid reacting to them and trade only when my broader plan calls for it.","I should review all positions together, including cash, and assess risk and allocation rather than treating each stock as a separate account that must break even."]}
